----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Glyph

  Root package of the Glyph embedded graphics framework.

  Glyph is a portable framebuffer-based graphics library written in Ada for
  embedded systems. The library provides reusable graphics primitives,
  display drivers, font rendering, image rendering, and widgets while
  remaining independent of any specific microcontroller or display.

  Initial development targets the RP2040 and SSD1306 OLED displays, but the
  architecture is designed to support additional hardware in the future.
